definition: A portion of data deliberately excluded from training and used exclusively for evaluating a model's generalization performance.
details: Held-out sets (a broader term encompassing validation and test sets) are fundamental to honest machine learning evaluation, providing a check against a model simply memorizing its training data.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. In plain words: A portion of data deliberately excluded from training and used exclusively for evaluating a model's generalization performance. Here is how it actually plays out: Held-out sets (a broader term encompassing validation and test sets) are fundamental to honest machine learning evaluation, providing a check against a model simply memorizing its training data. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Held-Out Set.
